id: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005)

facts.text: Champions, glory is on offer, but eat first. You will need the strength for what comes next.
facts.why: Invented. Dumbledore says nothing like this in the film. His lines are the tournament announcement, the champion selection and the Cedric eulogy.
facts.fix: Champions, eat before the ball. Three tasks will use up your strength soon enough.

fix_note.text: Champions, eat before the ball. Three tasks will use up your strength soon enough.

facts.text: Fleur's toast with the Beauxbatons girls.
facts.why: The transcript has Fleur named the Beauxbatons champion at the Great Hall feast, but no toast anywhere.
facts.fix: Fleur named champion, with the Beauxbatons girls.

vibe.verdict: A tidy Yule Ball invite with the dragon, the Goblet and the Beauxbatons carriage all in.
